items.title: Accenture Is Up 33% in a Month but Still Down 2% This Year. Is the Stock Cheap?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAccenture (ACN:NYSE) stock is up 37% in the past month but still up 2% in 2026. Even after the rally, Accenture still looks cheap against its own history, at 18x forward earnings against a 10-year average of 24x.

items.title: Accenture (ACN) Expands Its AI Work With A Major Consumer Goods Customer
items.summary: Accenture (NYSE:ACN) and Mondelēz International announced a new partnership to redesign the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process using agentic AI. The project focuses on streamlining complex workflows across ordering, invoicing and collections for Mondelēz International's global consumer packaged goods operations.
